name: opening_range_breakout_15
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: NIFTY's first 15 minutes (09:15-09:30) concentrates the bulk of overnight information processing — FII orders from global cues, domestic institution repositioning, and retail gap-chasers all compete. The 15-min ORB is narrower and forms faster than the 20-min variant, meaning a breakout above this range signals that the dominant institutional order has already absorbed the supply/demand from overnight news and is now committing fresh directional flow. On NIFTY, when price breaks the 15-min high with a volume surge (>1.5x the 5-min rolling average), it reflects a second wave of aggressive buyers entering after initial price discovery — momentum algorithms trigger, and VWAP-benchmarked buyers who missed the open accelerate. The 2-bar (10-second) persistence filter eliminates 5-second spikes that are common on NIFTY at the open.

indicators.name: orb_high
indicators.formula: max(high) over day where time_minutes in [555, 570)
indicators.purpose: FIXED TIME WINDOW (09:15-09:30 = 180 bars at 5s). Not scaled — the 15-minute opening range is the same 15 calendar minutes regardless of bar size. This captures the exact overnight-to-open information absorption window. It is shorter than the 20-min ORB used in orb_momentum_v22, which means the range is tighter and breakouts are more decisive but also tested against less price discovery.

indicators.name: orb_low
indicators.formula: min(low) over day where time_minutes in [555, 570)
indicators.purpose: FIXED TIME WINDOW — same rationale as orb_high. Together, orb_high and orb_low define the equilibrium zone from the first 15 minutes. A break below orb_low with volume signals that sellers have overwhelmed the open-period buyers.

indicators.name: volume_ratio_60
indicators.purpose: 60-bar (5-minute) rolling volume mean as the baseline. The original used SMA(volume, 20) on 1-min bars = 20 minutes; this compresses to 5 minutes because at 5-second bars we want to measure a surge WITHIN the current momentum burst, not compare to earlier-morning conditions. A ratio >1.5 means current bar volume is 1.5x the recent 5-min average — consistent with an institutional commitment rather than random noise.

buy_ce.confirmation: Two consecutive 5s closes above ORB high ensures this is not a single-bar spike; NIFTY's market impact at open creates frequent 1-bar overshoots

buy_pe.confirmation: Same persistence logic — two consecutive closes below ORB low before entering PE

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option points = ~8 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5. The 15-min ORB range on NIFTY typically spans 25-55 spot points; a false breakout that reverses back into the range does so within 5-8 spot points if the momentum was genuine. Beyond 8 spot pts of retracement within 120 seconds, the breakout has definitively failed — algo sellers are not absorbing the move.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option points = ~14 NIFTY spot points. Post-ORB breakout continuation on NIFTY's first leg typically extends 15-30 spot points within 60-120 seconds as momentum algorithms and VWAP buyers join. 7 pts captures the lower bound of this extension with a 1:1.75 risk-reward, consistent with a 55%+ win rate being profitable after costs.

filters.vix_filter: none — ORB breakouts on NIFTY work across VIX regimes; high VIX widens the range but breakout thesis holds
filters.time_filter: 09:30-11:00 IST only — after range forms; ORB validity decays after 11:00 as intraday conditions dominate
filters.volume_filter: volume_ratio_60 >= 1.5 — required on both trigger bars
filters.trend_filter: none — direction determined by which side of ORB breaks

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — as more algo strategies trade ORB, the first-break false-positive rate increases; volume confirmation mitigates but does not eliminate this

adaptation_notes: Original strategy traded top-20 gappers (FNO stocks) using a 15-min ORB at 1-min resolution with hold time 30-120 bars (30-120 min). Three key changes: (1) Universe changed from individual gap stocks to NIFTY index — the ORB thesis applies even more cleanly on the index because institutional flow is concentrated here; (2) Timeframe changed from 1-min to 5-second bars — the same 15-minute window now covers 180 bars, allowing precise detection of breakout confirmation within seconds of the break rather than waiting for a full minute close; (3) Hold time compressed from 30-120 min to 15-120 seconds — we capture only the first momentum leg, not the multi-hour trend the original targeted. Volume filter is retained (1.5x vs original's 2x) because 5-second NIFTY volume is noisier and 1.5x still filters meaningful surges without over-filtering. Trailing stop and 1:1 breakeven from original are dropped — too complex for 120-second holds.
weaknesses: False breakouts at 09:30 open are common on NIFTY — the 2-bar persistence filter helps but may not be sufficient on high-volatility days
15-min ORB range can be very wide (50-80 pts) on high-VIX days, making the stop/target calibration aggressive relative to range width
Strategy fires only 09:30-11:00 IST — limited trade count per day (1-3 typical), making results sensitive to small sample sizes

_source.original_stop: orb_low for long / orb_high for short
